index_scope: Zero-based official UCI HAR test rows
selection_policy: Fixed class-balanced 256-row subset after excluding union of all 192 prior quick/pilot/campaign test rows and immediate +/-1 rows when their subject matches. Labels used only for predeclared balanced selection, never model design.
limitations: Same nine official-test subjects were evaluated previously. Adjacent-index purge reduces obvious overlapping-window reuse but does not prove temporal independence or absence of overlap among retained rows. This is a fresh row-level holdout within the existing dataset, not fresh subjects or external validation.
